Both alerts in workflows/Opportunity.workflow-meta.xml carry a non-empty <recipients><type>owner</type></recipients> block, and deploy-order.md states the process ships active true with order left for manual Setup configuration and M3-S03's Apex naming the process explicitly -- both read consistently with what their manual tests claim, though this agent does not tick them.

set-status printed a plan-wide WARN naming this step: admin/validation-rules is cited in M3-S02.skills[] but no acceptance test on this step or on milestone M3 runs check_validation_rules.py. Per the invocation context this is advisory by decision and this agent takes no action on it; it is reported here as the AGENT_CONTRACT process-observations obligation, not as a defect in this run.

Nothing this agent could not resolve on its own: the withdrawn email-checker test left no residue in acceptance_tests[] (only in the amendment history), and the two argument surfaces check_approval_design.py's fixture history documents (--manifest-dir alone, positional-only, both together) behaved exactly as the step's own test description predicted when run here.
M3-S02 is now tested and ready for documentation.
